name: Passkey Broker
author: Maximilian-Maag
description: A system-wide WebAuthn authenticator for Omarchy. QtWebEngine advertises passkeys and provides no authenticator behind them, so this broker answers the ceremony itself — a FIDO2 security key where one is attached, or a fingerprint-gated software key otherwise — and a qutebrowser bridge hands the result to the page.

features: System-wide WebAuthn/passkey authenticator served over a token-gated loopback API
Hardware token backend (CTAP2 via libfido2): the private key never leaves the security key
Software ES256 backend gated by fprintd, for when no key is attached
qutebrowser Greasemonkey bridge that replaces navigator.credentials.create/get (and the platform-authenticator probe)
Unit + regression + integration + e2e + JS tests, mutation testing (>= 0.80) and policy as code
